AR-034.bottleneck: 0% win rate vs lb1009 Mega Lucario ex & lb945 Multiply Ivan across all previous decks

root_cause_analysis.lb1009_and_lb945_archetype: Pure Fighting {F} multi-attacker deck with 4x Mega Lucario ex (340 HP), 2x Hariyama (150 HP non-ex), 3x Solrock/Lunatone (110 HP), 4x Riolu, 3x Boss's Orders, 4x Carmine, 1x Hero's Cape.
root_cause_analysis.failure_mode_1: Mimikyu Safeguard blocks Mega Lucario ex, but Hariyama and Solrock (non-ex) bypass Safeguard and KO Mimikyu (70 HP).
root_cause_analysis.failure_mode_2: Opponent uses 3x Boss's Orders to pull benched Ogerpon ex around Mimikyu and OHKOs with Mega Brave (270 dmg).
root_cause_analysis.counter_vector: Exploit 2x PSYCHIC WEAKNESS across ALL opponent Fighting Pokémon (Riolu 80 HP -> 40 dmg OHKO, Makuhita 80 HP -> 40 dmg OHKO, Mega Lucario 340 HP -> 170 dmg OHKO).

key_tech: 2x XerneasEX (ID 331): Rising Horns deals 220 base dmg vs ex -> 440 DAMAGE with {P} weakness, OHKOing Mega Lucario ex even with Hero's Cape.
2x Flutter Mane (ID 56): Midnight Fluttering disables opponent active abilities; Hex Hurl (90/180 dmg) snipes benched Riolus.
2x Scream Tail ex (ID 969): T1 Scream locks opponent Supporter cards (Carmine/Lillie), Crunch discards active Fighting energy.
2x Lillie's Clefairy ex (ID 272): Full Moon Rondo deals 220 dmg (440 with {P} weakness) for 2 energy across 10 benched Pokémon.
1x Iron Leaves ex (ID 75): Rapid Vernier surprise pivot 180 dmg.
2x Tapu Bulu (ID 920): Preserves 75% WR vs Crustle (220 dmg non-ex).
2x Judge (ID 1213) + 1x Unfair Stamp (ID 1080): Preserves 25% WR vs Alakazam.
1x XerneasEX (ID 331) + 1x Iron Leaves ex (ID 75) + 2x Mimikyu (ID 767): Solves Lucario/Ivan.
